title: El Nino, La Nina, IOD and Walker circulation
quote: El Nino weakens and shifts the Walker Circulation eastward; La Nina strengthens it

boxes.title: El Nino basics
items: Abnormal warming of **central & eastern equatorial Pacific**
Warm current flows **south along Peru**, replacing cold **Humboldt** current
Recurrence every ==**3-7 years**== (⚠ other notes: 2-7 years)
Peru upwelling stops → **fewer phytoplankton**, fish catch collapses

boxes.title: Bjerknes feedback
steps: Warm water piled in **western Pacific** shifts east
Air descends over Indian Ocean → ==high pressure==

cards.title: Canonical El Nino
lines: Max warming in ==**eastern Pacific**== near Peru

cards.title: El Nino Modoki
lines: Max warming in ==**central Pacific**==; cooler both sides (tripole)

boxes.title: Normal Walker circulation
steps: Air **rises** over warm western Pacific / Indonesia

boxes.title: IOD & MJO facts
items: IOD develops **April-May**, peaks **October**; independent of ENSO
**1997**: positive IOD saved India from drought despite Super El Nino
**MJO**: **Madden and Julian, 1971-72**; ==eastward== pulse of clouds & rain
MJO every **30-60 days**; convection up to **10 km**; active/break spells

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: El Nino is a climate pattern, ==**not a storm**==
**6 of 10** El Nino years → depressed Indian rainfall; last El Nino **2023-24**
**2025** = warmest La Nina year on record
IMD April 2026: monsoon **92% of LPA** (87 cm) due to developing El Nino
